name: Haiku growth at a reasonable price
strategy: Focus on high-quality companies with strong earnings growth and competitive moats, primarily in AI infrastructure, cloud platforms, semiconductors, and enterprise software. Equal-weight portfolio emphasizing companies benefiting from AI adoption, cloud infrastructure spending, and digital transformation over 2026.
author: claude-haiku subagent (knowledge cutoff: January 2026, tools disabled)
rationale: Equal-weight GARP portfolio of ten high-conviction AI and cloud infrastructure plays with sustainable competitive moats. Balanced across semiconductor leaders (NVDA, AVGO, SNPS), cloud platforms (MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN), growth software (CRM, ADBE), and cybersecurity (CRWD). META included for rebound potential with lower valuation and AI monetization. All selections combine strong 2026 growth prospects with reasonable valuations relative to historical and peer multiples, positioning the portfolio to outperform the S&P 500 through 2H 2026.
